classification: owner-requested post-result development experiment; not validation
mapper_policy: Exact intersection of two independent isolated source-only semantic mappings. No birth/chart/candidate/rank/owner-answer information was supplied.

astronomy.ephemeris: Swiss Ephemeris local-file SWIEPH, tropical for Western traditions

hellenistic_western.house_mapping: For a mapped house, score the traditional whole-sign house lord under the same eligible atomic conditions.

lilly_traditional_western.house_mapping: For a mapped house, use the traditional ruler of the tropical sign on the Placidus cusp and the same eligible lord conditions.

parashari_jyotish.house_mapping: For a mapped sidereal whole-sign house, use its traditional sign lord and the same eligible lord conditions.

per_tradition_domain_state.definition: Conflict-preserving collapse: +1 when one or more positive atomic testimonies and no negatives; -1 when one or more negatives and no positives; 0 for mixed or no testimony.
per_tradition_domain_state.deduplication: An identical physical condition for the same planet counts once within a tradition-domain even if reached through multiple mapped roles. Distinct physical conditions and distinct traditions remain separate testimonies.

domain_collapse_nonstack.description: All traditions/testimonies for a behavioral domain collapse to at most one signed domain vote.
domain_collapse_nonstack.domain_vote: +1 if total positive testimonies across traditions exceed total negative; -1 if negative exceed positive; 0 if tied.

cross_tradition_convergence_stack.description: Each tradition may contribute at most one signed vote per behavioral domain; agreement across independently sourced traditions stacks.
cross_tradition_convergence_stack.domain_vote: sum of each mapped tradition's sign(net testimonies), so two or three agreeing traditions contribute two or three votes.
cross_tradition_convergence_stack.purpose: Primary owner-requested convergence hypothesis; rewards independent traditional convergence without rewarding verbosity within one tradition.

raw_independent_testimony_stack.description: Every frozen positive/negative testimony stacks, including multiple testimonies within the same tradition.
raw_independent_testimony_stack.domain_vote: sum of all positive testimony counts minus all negative testimony counts.
raw_independent_testimony_stack.purpose: Tests the strongest version of the owner's stacking hypothesis.
raw_independent_testimony_stack.interpretation_guard: If only this raw arm succeeds, label RAW_STACK_ONLY_WARNING because rule-count/verbosity can drive the result.

behavioral_weight_variants.equal_domain: Every mapped participant-supported behavioral domain has weight 1; unsupported/not-established domains abstain.
behavioral_weight_variants.frozen_measurement_confidence: Use the already-frozen target-blind behavioral confidence for that domain; no astrology-side salience/directness weight is used.

scoring.reason: The stacking arms explicitly test whether convergence itself carries signal; domain-collapse provides the non-stacking control.

arm_admission.rule: Evaluate each aggregation family under both behavioral-weight variants. A family passes the direct regression only if target strictly beats 2013 and no same-date alternative strictly beats target in BOTH weight variants.
arm_admission.raw_arm_rule: Raw stacking is reported regardless, but raw-only direct success does not by itself admit a century ranking.

robustness_labels.robust_multi_family: Two or more clean aggregation families pass.
robustness_labels.convergence_specific: Cross-tradition convergence passes while domain-collapse does not.
robustness_labels.nonstack_specific: Domain-collapse passes while convergence does not.

no_claims: This does not scientifically validate any astrological tradition.
Source-native traditional rules are provenance-backed, not empirically calibrated probabilities.

negative_control.permutation_unit: Within each tradition independently, permute the complete nonempty source-grounded domain-significator bundle across the 19 frozen behavioral domain IDs; preserve each tradition's number of mapped bundles and each bundle's planet/house content.
negative_control.evaluation: Use the same six scoring specifications and the same direct query set. Count a permutation as matching/exceeding observed separation for a specification only if it passes that specification's frozen direct-regression criterion and its target-minus-strongest-competitor margin is >= the observed margin.
negative_control.interpretation: Development overfit/flexibility diagnostic only; not a formal p-value for astrology.

testimony_semantics_authority: The tradition registry is normative for eligible atomic testimony conditions. This scoring freeze is normative for behavioral-weight variants, aggregation arms, direct-regression admission, and the negative control.
